endorsements.quote: Before acquiring a digital pathology platform, the regulatory framework must be reviewed carefully.
This includes confirmation of CE-IVD status within the European Union as well as any additional national requirements that govern the use of diagnostic software and related modules
A detailed assessment of site-specific prerequisites and requirements should be completed before selecting a digital pathology platform.

unlisted_practices: Select digital pathology platforms that support a wide range of whole slide image formats, including the native format of existing scanners, to avoid repeated file conversion.
Select digital pathology platforms that support integration of external third-party algorithmic applications to avoid vendor lock-in.
Establish at least one on-site IT expert with clear technical responsibilities and authority for digital pathology operations.
Prefer digital pathology platforms that provide accessible, country-based local vendor technical support and verify the availability and scope of that support.

screen.reason: Structured landscape analysis and guidance paper providing practical recommendations for health care organizations to select and implement digital pathology platforms with AI.
